
### thread_sum memory layout (1)

![](/threads/texfig/thread-sum-two-stacks.figure-1.svg){fig-alt="memory layout of program from highest address to lowest ---  reserved by OS (at 0xFFFF...); some unused space; main thread stack (at 0x7F...); some unused space; sum_front_thread stack; some unused space; sum_back_thread stack; heap/other dynamic; code/data (at 0x400000); some unused space. Part of the code/data region includes values and results"}

### thread_sum memory layout (2, showing threads)

![](/threads/texfig/thread-sum-two-stacks.figure-2.svg){fig-alt="same memory layout with sum_front_thread and sum_back_thread shown. Each thread has a PC, registers, ...; the PCs point to sum_back and sum_front in the code regions, and the registers include a pointer to each threads' stack regions."}
